description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different attributes on a multi-retrieval task, with a sample size of n=2. The horizontal axis represents the attributes, which include city, hobby, university, major, and birthdate. The vertical axis indicates the accuracy percentage, ranging from 0 to 100. Each attribute is represented by a distinct color: city (green), hobby (orange), university (blue), major (purple), and birthdate (red). The chart compares the accuracy of these attributes across four different tasks: Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b. The accuracy values for each attribute vary across the tasks, with some attributes showing higher accuracy in certain tasks. The chart does not include any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding on the bars, and there is no indication of the bars being sorted in any specific order.
